flow: SC Susceptible Children->UVC Un-monitored Vaccinated Children
SC Susceptible Children->MVC Monitored Vaccinated Children

UVC Un-monitored Vaccinated Children->EC Exposed Children

param: Λ Birth rate into the susceptible children compartment.
μ Natural death rate for all compartments (1 / (72 years * 52 weeks/year)).
j Maturation rate from child compartments to adult compartments (1 / (15 years * 52 weeks/year)).
β_C Transmission rate for children, representing infection from contact with infectious individuals.
β_A Transmission rate for adults, representing infection from contact with infectious individuals.
ε Vaccine failure factor, representing the relative susceptibility of un-monitored vaccinated individuals compared to susceptibles. (1-ε) is vaccine effectiveness.
δ Progression rate from Exposed to Infectious state (1 / 10 days).
γ Recovery rate from Infectious to Recovered state (based on a 15-day recovery period).
x_U Vaccination rate for susceptible children entering the un-monitored vaccination program.
x_M Vaccination rate for susceptible children entering the monitored vaccination program.
x_A Vaccination rate for susceptible adults (catch-up vaccination program).
h_M Rate of developing full immunity for children in the monitored vaccination group.
h_A Rate of developing full immunity for adults in vaccinated groups (VA and UVA).
h_U Rate of developing full immunity for children in the un-monitored vaccination group.
εβ_C Effective transmission rate for un-monitored vaccinated children.
εβ_A Effective transmission rate for un-monitored vaccinated adults.
